prompts.tsukiyo: Use case: stylized-concept. Production sprite animation sheet for MAAI. Reference image defines EXACT character identity, clothing, face, anatomy, weapon and monochrome ink style: Tsukiyo, delicate elegant woman, long flowing high ponytail, white kimono, dark hakama, ONE slender katana in both hands. Create ONE transparent PNG sprite sheet, landscape 1536x1024 if possible, perfectly regular 3 columns by 2 rows, exactly SIX complete full-body isolated cels. ALL six figures face RIGHT in the same three-quarter side view for a 2D fighting game, same body size and camera. Each cel stays wholly in its own cell with generous transparent gutters. Feet at same baseline within each row. No background, no grid, no shadows on ground, no labels, no numerals, no text, no effects or particles. Preserve detailed black and white ink drawing, white clothing remains opaque. Top row left to right: (1) quickly lift weapon to protect torso, knees soft, (2) successful precise parry, weapon intercepting a blow from the right at chest height, compact powerful deflection, (3) flowing finish of deflection ready to counterattack. Bottom row left to right: (4) OWN attack has been deflected, weapon jolts UP and away, arms pulled back and torso recoils slightly LEFT, (5) absorb that recoil with bent knees, weapon still displaced, (6) regain balanced original fighting guard facing RIGHT. These are animation poses of SAME character; not different designs. Anatomically plausible hands with correct grips, keep weapons straight and continuous, delicate characters retain grace. Full weapons and every foot entirely visible in every cell. No opponent.
